Cats are arriving in RSPCA centres faster than they can be rehomed, and the charity is asking people across England and Wales to consider adopting. Pet owners are being urged to neuter their cats as kittens are increasingly being found dumped in perilous conditions. Continue reading...

title: The pet I’ll never forget: Orlando was paralysed and almost died – then became the perfect guide dog
summary: He had tetanus and I was brokenhearted when it seemed as if he wouldn’t pull through. I’m a puppy raiser for the charity Guide Dogs ; the puppies come to live with us in Swanley, Kent, until they are 12 to 18 months old.
